incoming.name: Newsround
incoming.excerpt: Newsround was the first BBC television programme to break the news of the loss of the Space Shuttle Challenger on 28 January 1986.

incoming.name: Richard Feynman
incoming.excerpt: Feynman was requested to serve on the Presidential Rogers Commission which investigated the Challenger disaster of 1986.

incoming.name: Space Shuttle Columbia disaster
incoming.excerpt: Following protocols established after the loss of Challenger, an independent investigating board was created immediately following the accident.

outgoing.name: Florida
outgoing.excerpt: From time to time, further pieces of debris from the orbiter wash up on the Florida coast.
